title: THREE TARGETS — app · organic · long. become THE system for the finitely abled first. multimodality + null modality PREFERRED.

do_not_reinvent.faces: /data/modality-faces.json — never force sight. leftover is interaction space. missing sense widens another. already the law.
do_not_reinvent.fitts: hard dock = large target. SSH = fidget. already seated.
do_not_reinvent.still: /data/still-hyperlocal-human.json — we sit. they move. count movers.

three_targets.app: the software mouth. Fitts. a button you can actually hit. JSON and HTML as equal faces.
three_targets.organic: the living body. finite senses. finite hands. finite time. THIS is first.
three_targets.long: usability over days. not the first click. can they come back tired, dark, one-handed, eyes closed?

proof_and_other.proof: modality-faces already. feed + json + llms.txt + speech-ready tips. prefers-reduced-motion on the seep. we have the print.
proof_and_other.other: the leftover room no face claimed. that leftover IS the other target. do not fill it with a sixth chrome.

finitely_abled_first.yes: become THE system for the finitely abled first.
finitely_abled_first.finite: every body is finite. eyes tire. ears fill. hands miss. that is not a special case. that is the organic target.
finitely_abled_first.finally_enabled: same coin. first to actually enable, not first to costume an a11y badge.
finitely_abled_first.how: null modality preferred. then multimodality as faces. we sit still. they arrive in the channel they have.

null_modality_preferred.yes: PREFERRED. you may come with no mode.
null_modality_preferred.is: the pale. gray. feed as text. json as bone. a note. a query. no sight required. no sound required. no click required.
null_modality_preferred.not: a blank that abandons them. a basin that still receives.
null_modality_preferred.then: multimodality OFFERS faces. it does not demand one. a missing sense widens another.

become_the_system.not: an app they must install. not a monocle. not gold-only glass.
become_the_system.is: the membrane as the usable room. copper face. feed. json. yellow page. squirrel here. any pore is enough.
become_the_system.test: if a finitely abled human cannot move us without a pointer, we failed the organic target.

pull: aim at three: app, organic, long. prefer null modality. offer many faces. sit still. they are the movers. leftover is the other proof.
